column1: # The equivalence case matrix, TAB-separated: name<TAB>entry<TAB>args
# THE SEPARATOR IS A REAL TAB. isONclust's version of this file was first
# written space-aligned for readability; `read -r name entry args` with IFS=tab
# then put the whole line into $name, every case ran with NO arguments, and all
# 29 goldens recorded the same default invocation -- reported as 29 passes.
# Nothing in the output said so; the case count and the file count were both
# plausible. equivalence.sh now refuses to run if any line is not tab-separated
# into three fields. If you edit this file, do not let an editor expand tabs.
# WHAT IS SWEPT, AND WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT
# Every parameter that can change an output file. Two collisions are INTENDED
# and must stay: `default` == `ont` == `k13w20` pins both the defaults and that
# --ont resolves to --k 13 --w 20, and `t8` == `t8_total_nt` pins that total_nt
# is the default --batch_type. Everything else should produce a result no other
# case produces; on test/Supplementary_File1_reads.fastq the pre-consensus
# cases already do, bar `--q 0`, which is a property of the data.
#   Nothing about --sample_size any more. It WAS excluded, because the draw came
#     from an unseeded generator and five runs of the same command gave five
#     different answers (PORTING.md, Finding 1). Since 0.3.2 it is seeded from
#     --seed, so the cases below are meaningful. Note the sizes are 100 and 200
#     rather than 500: the guard is `0 < sample_size < len(read_array)`, so a
#     size at or above the surviving read count silently takes every read and
#     the case collapses onto `default`. 500 does that on the 280-read smoke
#     corpus. `top_huge` keeps that no-op path covered deliberately.
#   --q 12 and up.  Filters every read on both corpora. That is Finding 7's
#     crash, now guarded; it has a CLI case rather than an output case, because
#   --k below 10 or above 30, and (k,w) in {11,16,21,26}x{99,100} u
#   --d.  Diagnostic only; it changes no output file. --d 0 is a CLI case
#   --medaka_model.  Needs a specific model downloaded; not reproducible here.
# THE CONSENSUS CASES NEED EXTERNAL BINARIES on PATH -- spoa for all of them,
# plus racon and minimap2, plus medaka. `equivalence.sh env` reports which are
# present and `record` skips the cases whose tool is missing rather than
# recording a crash as a golden.
